instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium close-up. In a bright winter forest, the woman with curly hair (R1) wearing a black puffer jacket and a gray scarf looks off to the left with a soft, serene smile. The man in the gray beanie (R2) wearing a plaid jacket stands close behind her, looking at her face with an affectionate, gentle smile. He wraps his arm over her shoulder in a warm embrace, holding her close. Bright, natural daylight illuminates the couple, creating soft winter tones and a beautifully blurred background.
